source_title: ONE LAST SHOT Get it Now On Digital and DVD
source_excerpt:
Seasoned Navy SEAL Jake Harris (Scott Adkins) is called back into action when the world is threatened by disillusioned former comrade turned domestic terrorist, Elliot Carter (Steven Cree). With the Joint Chiefs of Staff held hostage in a nuclear bunker, time is running short before Carter extracts the nuclear codes and plunges the world into chaos. To track down and prevent the mastermind from taking control of the U.S. missile defense network, Harris must lead his team into enemy territory against a brutal barrage of mercenaries, deadly traps, and a reckoning with his own checkered past. Also starring Hannah Ware and Dolph Lundgren.
